description: Same eFashion SL-SDK/IDT XML model as universe_sdk_xml, but the data-foundation join is written with fully schema/catalog-qualified identifiers ("CSA"."TJ"."ORDER_FACT"."CUSTOMER_KEY" = ...). Guards the parseJoinKeys N-part fix: before it, a qualified join failed the bare Table.Col regex and was silently dropped, yielding 0 relationships and a workbook that could only reach one table's columns. The relationship (and the cross-element joined columns) must still resolve.
